audit.whatIsWrong: Not a single cooldown appears anywhere in either layer. breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t all say 'track Disdain' with no number, and Purge is described only as an attack-speed ramp.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 — a genuinely long engage cooldown that Galio can play around, and it also shields Urgot, so a spent Disdain means both no engage and no shield for roughly 16 seconds. Purge is 12/9/6/3/0 and costs 40/30/20/10/0: at rank 5 it is a permanently available, free channel, which is why the lane gets worse and not better. Corrosive Charge is 10s at 800 range and Fear Beyond Death is 100/85/70 at 2500. None of that is on the page.
audit.corrected: Disdain 16s at rank 1 and it carries his shield — the 16 seconds after he spends it are your only all-in window. Purge goes from 12s down to no cooldown and no cost at rank 5. Corrosive Charge 10s at 800; Fear Beyond Death 100s at 2500.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why says 'the dash is interruptible and root-able mid-flight'.
audit.why: Justice Punch cannot be interrupted once it is travelling, and Urgot has no root anywhere in his kit — Corrosive Charge slows, Purge slows Urgot himself, Disdain displaces, Fear Beyond Death impales and slows. The claim invents an answer Urgot does not own and hides the one he does: Disdain is a displacement, and Purge is a self-slow.
audit.corrected: Urgot has no root. His answer to your commit is Disdain, a 475-range displacement that also shields him — and Purge slows Urgot himself while he channels it, which is the only time he is slower than you.
sources: champ-data/_kits/urgot.json (E Disdain: 'he will stop and hurl them out of his way', flags projectile,hardCC,shield; W Purge: 'Urgot slows himself while he unloads')

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer mentions that Disdain grants Urgot a shield, or that Purge slows Urgot.
audit.why: Both change how you sequence. Disdain's shield means bursting a fresh flip is throwing damage into a wall, so the Justice Punch has to come after the flip is spent, not into it. Purge's self-slow is the single window where Galio can actually walk away from him or land a 650-unit charge on a target who cannot reposition — the entry currently treats Purge purely as incoming damage.
audit.corrected: Disdain shields him on cast, so damage into a fresh flip is wasted. Purge slows Urgot while it channels — that is the window to punch in or walk out, and it is the only time you are faster.
sources: champ-data/_kits/urgot.json (E flags: projectile, hardCC, shield; W: 'Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon')

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 advice is 'flag a teammate and drop a knockup-taunt onto another map' with no mention that Fear Beyond Death can stop the channel.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance channels for 2.75 seconds and only becomes CC-immune after 1.25 seconds. Fear Beyond Death is a 2500-range projectile that impales the first champion it hits. Urgot does not have to be near you to punish the first 1.25 seconds of your ultimate, and the entry's whole level-6 plan runs through that channel.
audit.corrected: Hero's Entrance is CC-immune only after 1.25 seconds of its 2.75-second channel, and Fear Beyond Death reaches 2500 — start the channel out of his line, not in lane in front of him.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (Hero's Entrance channels 2.75s, CC immunity after 1.25s)

audit.why: The packet flags "Shield of Durand's" and "Use Winds of War" as probable wrong ability names. Both are false positives from the near-miss matcher; the names are correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Corrosive Charge (Q) with a 'dash' flag.
audit.why: Corrosive Charge is 'an explosive charge at the target location' — a ground-targeted skillshot with no movement on it at all. The flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire on the word 'charge' and would wrongly suggest Urgot has a second gap-closer. Nothing on the page acts on it, so no text change is needed, but it should not be trusted by any downstream rule.
audit.corrected: Urgot's only movement ability is Disdain (E). Corrosive Charge does not move him.

edits.before: Urgot is the textbook lane your shield does nothing for — his Corrosive Charge (Q) and Purge (W) shotgun legs deal percent-max-HP physical damage, so Shield of Durand's magic-amplified reduction is wasted and your tankiness just hands him bigger chunks to bite. Level 1-2 you have one ability and no engage, so give up the push and last-hit from max Winds of War range; do not walk into shotgun-leg range to land a single Q. Your one early breath is Level 3: with Q-W-E up you can punish him stepping forward — start the W channel, release the taunt mid-step, then Justice-Punch through him — but only commit if he over-extends first, because he is immobile and hates eating a taunt with no flip to escape it.
edits.after: Urgot is the textbook lane your shield does nothing for — his Corrosive Charge (Q) and Purge (W) legs deal percent-max-HP physical damage, and Shield of Durand cuts physical by only 12.5% at rank 1 against 25% versus magic, so your tankiness just hands him bigger chunks to bite. Level 1-2 you have one ability and no engage, so give up the push and last-hit with Winds of War at 825, just outside his 800 charge; never step inside the 490 his legs cover to squeeze in one more Q. Your one early breath is Level 3, and it is conditional: Disdain shields him on cast and runs 16 seconds at rank 1, so start the W channel, release the taunt mid-step and punch through him only once that flip is already spent.

notes: Kit-file flag misfire worth knowing: Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q) is tagged 'dash' but Riot's description is 'Fires an explosive charge at the target location' — no movement. Disdain (E) is his only mobility. Galio facts verified at wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio and reused across this slice: Shield of Durand cuts magic 25/30/35/40/45% and physical exactly half (12.5/15/17.5/20/22.5%), with a passive magic shield of 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% max health restoring after 12/10/8s out of combat; the taunt lands on release, radius 175-350, duration 0.5-1.5s by channel time. Justice Punch knocks up 0.75s, cannot be interrupted mid-travel (only an immobilise during cast time stops activation), is disabled while Grounded, and halts on terrain or champions. Winds of War 825, tornado 2s, no slow. Hero's Entrance channels 2.75s, CC-immune after 1.25s, gives allies the W magic shield for 5s. Colossal Smash is a 5s empowered auto scaling with 60% bonus MR. Galio kit flags also misfire: E tagged 'terrain' and missing 'knockup' despite the description. UNVERIFIED and therefore left untouched: whether a displacement such as Disdain cancels Justice Punch once the charge is already travelling — the wiki says the dash cannot be interrupted mid-travel but does not address forced movement, so I removed the false 'root-able mid-flight' claim without replacing it with a displacement claim I cannot source.
